summary.text: Susan Buchser-Lochocki is an independent write-in candidate for the West Virginia House of Delegates, District 77, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
According to Ballotpedia, she earned a bachelor's degree from Parsons School of Design at The New School in 1988.

paragraphs.text: Buchser-Lochocki was born at Travis Air Force Base in California.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she worked as an illustrator and later in banking, where she held Series 7 and 63 licenses, and that she married in Switzerland in 1999.

She said she has been a business owner, activist and author, and volunteered in women's clubs for more than 20 years; Ballotpedia lists affiliations with the Federation of American Women's Clubs Overseas, the American Women's Club of Zurich and the Girl Scouts of America.
She said she now lives in Morgantown.

In the survey, Buchser-Lochocki said her campaign aims to remove frivolous laws and regulations and bring government documents up to date, and she named human potential as a policy area she cares about.
